decision: D1, decided 2026-09-25: the published counter sheets, transcribed and reviewed, are the source of record for printed counter values (ASL Unit Requirements, section 12).
d1Departure: On 2026-09-25 the user asked Claude to fill in the worksheet itself. No physical counter sheets were available to Claude, so this transcription reads the registered rulebook's charts instead: A1.1 (p. 44) says the values of each unit are listed on the National Capabilities Chart (A25). Values the charts do not show are recorded as not-in-source. The reviewer should compare every row with the published counters; where a counter and the chart differ, the counter governs under D1.
scope: The thirteen counters the Scenario A1 catalog needs, listed in scenario-a1.counter-worksheet.csv: the four counters of the reviewed Scenario A1 cases, and nine added on 2026-09-26 for the Fire package (unit step 18): the Russian HS for Casualty Reduction, and the Replacement units and leaders of A19.13. And four MG counters added on 2026-09-26 for unit step 23, whose values no registered source gives: they are manufactured under ruling R0.3 of the ASL Unit Rally and Fire Extensions Plan and recorded under sheet MFG. No other counter is registered by this record. And, on 2026-09-27 for unit steps 27 and 28 (Leader Creation and Heat of Battle), 25 counters: the classes Battle Hardening exchanges units for (A15.3) from the National Capabilities Chart (sheet NCC: the German squared-E 4-6-8 and its HS, the Russian squared-E 4-5-8, plain-1 5-2-7, plain-E 6-2-8, and NKVD 6-2-8 (A25.25), with their HS), every leader grade of both sides (sheet LGR), and a hero of each side (sheet CEX). And, on 2026-09-27 for unit step 24 (ordnance), four counters: an Infantry crew of each side from the National Capabilities Chart (sheet NCC, 2-2-8 with A1.123), the German 7.5cm leIG 18 from the German Ordnance Listing (sheet OLG), and the Russian 45mm PTP obr. 32 from the Russian Ordnance Listing (sheet OLR). And, on 2026-09-27 for unit step 25 (vehicles), three vehicles from the Chapter H Vehicle Listings: the German Opel 6700 (Blitz) truck and SPW 251/1 halftrack (sheet VLG) and the Russian GAZ-MM truck (sheet VLR). And, on 2026-09-28 for the backlog pass 7 (armor), two closed-topped tanks from the same listings: the German PzKpfw IIIH (sheet VLG, p. 337) and the Russian T-34 M41 (sheet VLR, p. 355). And, on 2026-09-28 for the backlog pass 8, three listing values of each Gun: its BPV, its dates of use, and whether it may be Animal-Packed (German Ordnance Note O).
scenario: Eastern Front village fight on board 01: a German 1st Line rifle platoon (4-6-7 squads, with a 2-4-7 half-squad already in the stacking-case building) clears buildings held by a Russian 1st Line rifle company (squared-1 4-4-7 squads) under an 8-0 leader, fighting concealed and from fortified buildings.

extraction.method: Underlines, superscripts, and class borders were read visually from PyMuPDF 1.27.1 renderings of the chart regions at 3x to 6x zoom; the renderings are not committed. The text layer was used only to locate rows.
extraction.counterArtwork: The counter pictures beside the charts were not used as evidence (ASL-UNIT-012).

review.method: The user reviewed all 57 rows in conversation on 2026-09-25, as a table of every value with the chart each came from, and confirmed them all without correction. The not-in-source rows remain unknown. On 2026-09-26 the user reviewed the 130 rows added for the Fire package, as a table of every value with the chart it came from, and accepted them; the user supplied the broken morale of the three leaders from the printed counters, since the rulebook shows it only in counter artwork (ASL-UNIT-012), and it is recorded under sheet USR. On 2026-09-26 the user ruled (R0.3) that printed values no source gives are manufactured, and delegated the pass that needs them (unit steps 19 to 23) without further review; the 40 rows of sheet MFG were manufactured under that ruling and were not reviewed value by value. The reviewer column names the record's reviewer because the builder requires it; for sheet MFG it records the delegation, not a comparison with a counter. On 2026-09-27, under the user's approval of the Deviations, Ordnance, and Vehicles Plan, which replaces the user's review with an independent second pass, the rows of the 25 counters added for unit steps 27 and 28 were reviewed value by value by a separate agent briefed as a skeptical ASL rules referee, who rendered each chart region itself and confirmed every value; its reviewer column names that agent. It found that a Russian Conscript Battle Hardens into NKVD 2nd Line (A25.25), not 1st Line, and the NKVD counters were added and confirmed in turn. The leaders' broken morale rests on one printed example (the German 9-1 of page 676). On 2026-09-27, for unit step 24, the 78 rows of the two crews and two Guns were reviewed value by value by the same kind of independent referee agent, which rendered the listing rows and the chart itself; the Guns' overscored caliber, suffix, and Target Size were read from the rendering. The Guns' malfunctioned sides are not in any registered source and stay not-in-source; Gun repair is not built. On 2026-09-27, for unit step 25, the rows of the three vehicles were reviewed value by value by the same kind of independent referee agent, from renderings of the listing rows and the span colors and fonts of the page (black MP, italic cs#). On 2026-09-28, for the backlog pass 7, the 86 rows of the two tanks were reviewed value by value by the same kind of independent referee agent, from renderings of the listing rows, the span fonts (this edition prints the counters' red values in bold), the Listings Key, and the C8.12 Ammunition Supply Chart. On 2026-09-28, for the backlog pass 8, the six rows of the two Guns' BPV, dates, and Animal-Pack capability were reviewed by the same kind of independent referee agent from renderings of the listing rows and the German Ordnance Notes.

meaning.rules: Counter anatomy defines what each printed value means: A1.21 to A1.25 (p. 44), A1.4 (p. 45), A10.7 (p. 68), A25.01 (p. 93); physical PDF pages.

distribution: Printed values are recorded as facts. No counter artwork, scans, photographs, or chart images are committed, and the charts are not copied (ASL-UNIT-072).

crossChecks.vasl: Not used. D1 allows VASL piece definitions only as a local, uncommitted cross-check after a licensing review, which has not been run.
